048/** Test cases for the Elasticsearch query visitor. */
049public class OccurrenceEsQueryVisitorTest {
050
051  private static final OccurrenceSearchParameter PARAM = OccurrenceSearchParameter.CATALOG_NUMBER;
052  private static final OccurrenceSearchParameter PARAM2 =
053      OccurrenceSearchParameter.INSTITUTION_CODE;
054
055  private static final ObjectMapper objectMapper = new ObjectMapper();
056
057  private final EsFieldMapper<OccurrenceSearchParameter> fieldMapper =
058      new OccurrenceEsFieldMapperTest();
059  private final OccurrenceEsQueryVisitor visitor =
060      new OccurrenceEsQueryVisitor(fieldMapper, Constants.COL_DATASET_KEY);
061
062  private void assertQueryEquals(String expectedJson, String actualQuery)
063      throws JsonProcessingException {
064    JsonNode expected = objectMapper.readTree(expectedJson.trim());
065    JsonNode actual = objectMapper.readTree(actualQuery);
066    assertEquals(expected, actual);
067  }
068
069  @Test
070  public void testEqualsPredicate() throws QueryBuildingException, JsonProcessingException {
071    Predicate p = new EqualsPredicate<>(PARAM, "value", false);
072    String query = visitor.buildQuery(p);

074        "{\n"
075            + "          \"bool\": {\n"
076            + "            \"filter\": [\n"
077            + "              {\n"
078            + "                \"term\": {\n"
079            + "                  \"catalog_number.keyword\": {\n"
080            + "                    \"value\": \"value\"\n"
081            + "                  }\n"
082            + "                }\n"
083            + "              }\n"
084            + "            ]\n"
085            + "          }\n"
086            + "        }\n";
087    assertQueryEquals(expectedQuery, query);
088  }

112  @Test
113  public void testEqualsDatePredicate() throws QueryBuildingException, JsonProcessingException {
114    Predicate p = new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.EVENT_DATE, "2021-09-16", false);
115    String query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
116    String expectedQuery =
117        "{\n"
118            + "          \"bool\": {\n"
119            + "            \"filter\": [\n"
120            + "              {\n"
121            + "                \"range\": {\n"
122            + "                  \"event_date\": {\n"
123            + "                    \"gte\": \"2021-09-16\",\n"
124            + "                    \"lt\": \"2021-09-17\",\n"
125            + "                    \"relation\": \"within\"\n"
126            + "                  }\n"
127            + "                }\n"
128            + "              }\n"
129            + "            ]\n"
130            + "          }\n"
131            + "        }\n";
132    assertQueryEquals(expectedQuery, query);
133
134    // An InPredicate should be exactly the same
135    p = new InPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.EVENT_DATE, Arrays.asList("2021-09-16"), false);
136    query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
137    expectedQuery =
138        "{\n"
139            + "          \"bool\": {\n"
140            + "            \"should\": [\n"
141            + "              {\n"
142            + "                \"bool\": {\n"
143            + "                  \"filter\": [\n"
144            + "                    {\n"
145            + "                      \"range\": {\n"
146            + "                        \"event_date\": {\n"
147            + "                          \"gte\": \"2021-09-16\",\n"
148            + "                          \"lt\": \"2021-09-17\",\n"
149            + "                    \"relation\": \"within\"\n"
150            + "                        }\n"
151            + "                      }\n"
152            + "                    }\n"
153            + "                  ]\n"
154            + "                }\n"
155            + "              }\n"
156            + "            ]\n"
157            + "          }\n"
158            + "        }\n";
159    assertQueryEquals(expectedQuery, query);
160
161    p =
162        new InPredicate<>(
163            OccurrenceSearchParameter.EVENT_DATE, Arrays.asList("2021-09-16", "2024-01-17"), false);
164    query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
165    expectedQuery =
166        "{\n"
167            + "          \"bool\": {\n"
168            + "            \"should\": [\n"
169            + "              {\n"
170            + "                \"bool\": {\n"
171            + "                  \"filter\": [\n"
172            + "                    {\n"
173            + "                      \"range\": {\n"
174            + "                        \"event_date\": {\n"
175            + "                          \"gte\": \"2021-09-16\",\n"
176            + "                          \"lt\": \"2021-09-17\",\n"
177            + "                    \"relation\": \"within\"\n"
178            + "                        }\n"
179            + "                      }\n"
180            + "                    }\n"
181            + "                  ]\n"
182            + "                }\n"
183            + "              },\n"
184            + "              {\n"
185            + "                \"bool\": {\n"
186            + "                  \"filter\": [\n"
187            + "                    {\n"
188            + "                      \"range\": {\n"
189            + "                        \"event_date\": {\n"
190            + "                          \"gte\": \"2024-01-17\",\n"
191            + "                          \"lt\": \"2024-01-18\",\n"
192            + "                    \"relation\": \"within\"\n"
193            + "                        }\n"
194            + "                      }\n"
195            + "                    }\n"
196            + "                  ]\n"
197            + "                }\n"
198            + "              }\n"
199            + "            ]\n"
200            + "          }\n"
201            + "        }\n";
202    assertQueryEquals(expectedQuery, query);
203  }

638  @Test
639  public void testDisjunctionPredicate() throws QueryBuildingException, JsonProcessingException {
640    Predicate p1 = new EqualsPredicate<>(PARAM, "value_1", false);
641    Predicate p2 = new EqualsPredicate<>(PARAM2, "value_2", false);
642    Predicate p3 = new EqualsPredicate<>(PARAM, "value_3", false);
643
644    DisjunctionPredicate p = new DisjunctionPredicate(Arrays.asList(p1, p2, p3));
645    String query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
646    String expectedQuery =
647        "{\n"
